_comment: Known historical secret exposures. A finding whose fingerprint is absent here FAILS the build. A finding listed here still FAILS while revoked=false, because an exposed credential that has not been rotated is an open incident, not an accepted risk. Only a VERIFIED-REVOKED credential may be baselined as passing.

findings.location: services/common/db_dsn.py (removed from HEAD; permanent in history at blob d61f6355)
findings.notes: Rotation requires provider console access. Set revoked=true ONLY after old-credential rejection and new-credential acceptance have both been proven. See docs/security/incidents/P0_DATABASE_CREDENTIAL_EXPOSURE_2026-08-19.md

findings.location: tests/api/test_jwt_security.py (historical blobs; HEAD reads the secret from env)
findings.verified_by: fingerprint compared against live SUPABASE_* secrets; no match
findings.notes: Hard-coded JWT signing secret used only to mint tokens for local tests. Never a live credential, so there is nothing to revoke. Verified by comparing its sha256 prefix against the live service-role key.
